stories.story_fr: Les ventes comparables ont augmenté de 2 % au premier trimestre, dépassant les prévisions et montrant des performances solides dans les catégories majeures ainsi que dans les initiatives Best Buy Ads et Marketplace.
stories.story_en: Comparable sales grew 2% in Q1, beating outlook and showing strong performance across major product categories and in Best Buy Ads and Marketplace initiatives.
stories.quote: Our comparable sales grew 2% versus last year, higher than our outlook, with positive comps across the majority of our major product categories and strong performance in our Best Buy Ads and Marketplace initiatives.

stories.story_fr: Best Buy a élargi son taux de revenu du résultat d'exploitation, traduisant une amélioration de la rentabilité au premier trimestre.
stories.story_en: Best Buy expanded its operating income rate, reflecting improved profitability in Q1.
stories.quote: We also drove operating income rate expansion and EPS growth.

stories.story_fr: Lancement et mise à l'échelle du Marketplace numérique aux États‑Unis, augmentant considérablement le nombre de produits disponibles pour les clients.
stories.story_en: Launched and scaled the U.S. digital Marketplace, dramatically increasing the product count available to customers.
stories.quote: We also launched and scaled our U.S. digital Marketplace, drastically increasing our available product count for our customers.

stories.story_fr: Best Buy Ads a presque doublé le nombre de partenaires publicitaires par rapport à l'année précédente, renforçant la nouvelle source de profit.
stories.story_en: Best Buy Ads nearly doubled the number of ad partners compared with the prior year, strengthening the new profit stream.
stories.quote: We ... grew Best Buy Ads, almost doubling the number of ad partners compared to the prior year.
